perspective:
Jose Castillo is aware of the following:

- He works with Patricia Ndiaye at a community bank, where he occasionally helps with maintenance and repairs. They have a friendly, professional relationship.
- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual during their shifts, and he remembered her as normally vibrant and energetic.
- He asked her if she was okay. She said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk. Patricia said she appreciated that and that it meant a lot.
- During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He brought up financial planning and said he had been reading about it. Patricia said she had been overwhelmed with bills lately and that discussing budgeting tips could be helpful.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips with her, and Patricia said she would take him up on it soon.
- Afterward, he worried he might have overstepped, so he told Patricia he was only trying to help, not pry. She assured him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his offer.
- He told Patricia he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend. She said she appreciated having someone to turn to.
- He sensed from their later conversation that Patricia appreciated his concern but preferred to handle her issues privately.
- He checked in with her again, asking about her weekend. Patricia said she was fine and planned a quiet weekend at home.
- He offered to be there if she needed anything or wanted to chat. Patricia thanked him and said she would keep it in mind.
- He continued to check in with Patricia at work and offered help with anything, even just getting coffee. Patricia said she was busy but handling it, thanked him for checking in, and told him it was great to have his support.
- He responded that they were all there to help each other out.
final_response:
From Jose’s perspective, his belief shifted when he actually overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments. That was something he observed directly, and it led him to think her withdrawal might be tied to financial stress.

ANSWER: b
